newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Huntington Beach, Calif., Auth..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Huntington Beach, Calif., Auth..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692 that the Huntington Beach Public

Financing Authority, Huntington Beach, California, intends to sell $8,000,000 approximate principal amount of its Lease Revenue Bonds, 1997 Series A, (Public Facilities Project), at public sale. Sealed bids will be received on:

at 10:00 a.m., at the offices of Rod Gunn Associates, Inc., 3010 Old Ranch Parkway, Suite 330, Seal Beach, CA 90740, telephone (562) 598-7677. The Notice Inviting Bids and the Preliminary Official Statement pertaining to the Bonds are being prepared and may be obtained from Rod Gunn Associates, Inc. at the address and telephone number listed above.
